#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define ll long long
using namespace std;

ll use[17];

int dfs(ll n, int di) {
    int res = (n / use[di]) * di;
    n %= use[di];
    if (n == 0) return res;
    return res + min(dfs(use[di] - n, di - 1) + di, dfs(n, di - 1));
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
        use[i] = use[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << dfs(n, 16) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
